description: Detect whether the model has memorized training data (exact + near-duplicate)

methodology.exact_match: Check if any test record text appears verbatim in model generations
methodology.near_duplicate: Check if generated text is >90% similar (character n-gram Jaccard) to any training record

test_set.description: Records held out from training, used to test memorization leakage
